Using the super-app's mini-app discovery feature, the son finds and installs a Go board game for the father; initial skepticism gives way to both father and son gaming together on their respective phones. Product tagline reveals: '다양한 게임, 설치 없이 토스에서 바로 / 앱을 쓰는 새로운 방식 / 토스 미니앱'.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: Ultra-clean Korean commercial advertising typography endcard, the final brand statement of the advertisement. The entire frame is a pure, completely unblemished white background (#FFFFFF) with zero texture, grain, or color variation. At the compositional center of this white field, a carefully spaced two-line typographic layout is arranged horizontally centered and vertically centered with generous negative space above and below. The character color of this first line is a dark medium grey (#444444), not black, chosen for its refined visual weight that reads as serious but not harsh against the white field. The letterforms are well-spaced with natural Korean character tracking, clean and modern. The second line of typography (the lower line), positioned below the first with a gap of approximately 1.2x line height, reads the product brand name '토스 미니앱' — rendered in the same clean geometric Korean sans-serif typeface but at a slightly larger size approximately 64 to 70pt equivalent, with bold weight, making it slightly more prominent than the tagline line. This product name has a deliberate and striking multi-color character treatment: the characters '토스' (Toss) are rendered in a rich dark navy color (#1A2540); a single space follows; then the character '미' (mi) is rendered in a vivid bright medium green (#34A853); immediately adjacent, the character '니' (ni) is also rendered in the same vivid bright medium green (#34A853); and finally the character '앱' (app) is rendered in a warm tan-khaki color (#B8A070). The result is the product name displayed as a multicolored typographic identity: dark navy brand name, then green-green-tan product name suffix, creating a vibrant playful color-coded brand word mark effect. At the very bottom center of the frame, at a distance approximately 8 to 10 percent of the frame height from the bottom edge, a single line of light grey small fine-print Korean text reads the disclaimer '*토스 미니앱 서비스는 만 19세 이상부터 이용할 수 있어요.' (meaning: Toss Mini-App service is available to those aged 19 and over.) in a grey light-weight small sans-serif. Additionally, in the final seconds of this shot, the brand's own visual identity mark appears centered: a rounded abstract symbol in gradient blue tones (resembling two overlapping curved arcs or a stylized speech bubble or wave form) positioned to the left, with the lowercase Latin wordmark 'toss' in dark near-black sans-serif positioned to its right — together forming a clean horizontal brand lock-up. The extreme negative white space above, below, and around the typography communicates confidence, minimalism, and premium brand positioning. Style: Korean brand advertising endcard, ultra-minimalist Bauhaus-adjacent typographic design, maximum white space exploitation, selective accent color identity typography, clean modern Korean commercial brand design system. The deliberate multi-color treatment of the product name '토스 미니앱' — using three different text colors within a single typographic unit — is a sophisticated brand design strategy that gives the product name its own distinct visual identity separate from the main brand name. The green characters (미니) and tan character (앱) together create a visual emphasis on the qualifier 'Mini-App' while keeping the parent brand name in its authoritative navy. This color system implies that the mini-app product line has its own sub-brand color palette within the parent brand's system. The disclaimer at the bottom (*토스 미니앱 서비스는 만 19세 이상부터 이용할 수 있어요.) is legally required in Korean advertising for financial services and its presence in the final frame confirms this is a regulated financial service product.
